On the right SOFIA: an eight-year-old red squirrel girl, clearly taller and older than Matvey, chestnut-orange fur, a cream muzzle and chest, tufted ears, a large fluffy curled tail, expressive warm amber eyes, a small ponytail tied with a plum hair band, wearing a stylish modern plum-purple athletic tracksuit (zip jacket with thin white side stripes, matching trousers) and white-and-lilac trainers; graceful confident posture of a girl who does acrobatics and synchronised swimming; no frills, no dress. Expressive faces, beautifully detailed soft fur. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no crests, no watermark.
